reuse.why: Reuses findOrCreateBank, syncAccount and shared link validation, but copies provider workflows and unlinkAccount's local cleanup.

duplication.why: Adds copies of the account-link workflow, Akahu transaction downloader and unlink cleanup field list.

placement.why: Provider integration follows existing module boundaries, although a validation-named helper now performs unlink mutations.

scope.why: Changes are focused on the requested linking rules and Fintegra integration, including necessary provider registry updates.

maintainability.why: Shared validation centralizes the new rules, but duplicated workflows and mutation inside assertNotLinkedElsewhere increase maintenance surprises.

bypasses_abstraction.where: assertNotLinkedElsewhere duplicates unlinkAccount's local cleanup instead of extracting a shared local-only unlink operation.

disguised_duplication.where: linkFintegraAccount and downloadFintegraTransactions reproduce existing provider implementations under new names, while unlink cleanup is embedded in a validation helper.

abstraction_drift.where: assertNotLinkedElsewhere grows closed-target validation and a replaceExistingLink mode that mutates prior holders; its cleanup bypasses unlinkAccount's shared semantics.
